svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Tank (obc-automation-tank, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Automation (P&ID). Box 192x216 px, anchor at (96,24). Bindable properties: _pn_level (default 50, read): Level (same unit as max) _pn_max (default 100, read): Maximum level / capacity _ps_trend (default 'stable', read): fast-rising | rising | stable | falling | fast-falling _ps_fluid (default 'fresh-water', read): Content colour (OpenBridge palette): fresh-water | sea-water | waste | masses | fuel | oil | steam | hot | cold | air-ventilation | acid-alkalis | fire-fighting | flammable-gas | non-flammable-gas _ps_tag (default 'T-101', read): Tank label (free text)
